caption: Controlled prediction-interface audit, not EEG/fMRI signal corruption or external validation. Missingness uses shared nested random masks (actual counts in JSON); both methods remove unavailable modalities. Shrinkage also scales quality-aware fMRI reliability mass; no model retraining. Apply perturbation per repeat before averaging. Points/95% intervals use 1,000 seed/class-stratified record resamples conditional on fitted models; intervals are not paired-difference significance tests. Both-unavailable and zero-reliability cases reject explicitly.
